content.short: Taiko is a fully Ethereum-equivalent ZK-Rollup (Type 1) scaling solution that inherits L1 security and liveness.
content.description:
Taiko is a leading developer-ready Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, powered by Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine (zkEVM) technology. As a Type 1 ZK-Rollup, Taiko achieves full bytecode-level equivalence with Ethereum, allowing developers to deploy existing dApps and tools with zero modifications. The network features a unique "Based Rollup" architecture, where Ethereum Layer 1 validators handle the sequencing of Taiko blocks, ensuring that the network inherits the robust liveness and decentralization of the Ethereum mainnet.

By utilizing advanced ZK-proofs, Taiko provides high throughput and significantly lower transaction costs while maintaining cryptographic integrity. The network is designed for mass adoption, serving as a foundational infrastructure for a wide range of use cases including DeFi, gaming, and social applications. Through its commitment to open-source principles and deep alignment with the Ethereum roadmap, Taiko is empowering the next generation of builders to create scalable and secure decentralized applications that prioritize user sovereignty and global accessibility.
